_comment: The super admins (ලොකු Admin): Google accounts that can open /admin and, from there, add or remove the normal admins (පොඩි admin). Super admins can only be changed here - edit, commit, redeploy. Capitals do not matter. To keep this list out of the public repo, set ADMIN_EMAILS (comma-separated) on Render and Netlify instead; it wins over this file.
